findings.claim: Generated formatters for [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] omit MessagePackSecurity handling for untrusted data. In contractless/surrogate mode, string-key deserialization of attacker-controlled maps emits a partial class that uses default templates. Collisions or depth tracking depend on the existing template emitting options.Security.DepthStep, which is not shown. Whether the user-declared formatter template path still calls DepthStep is not verified by the diff.

receipt_plan.detail: Add a generator snapshot test for a [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] class and confirm the generated Deserialize contains options.Security.DepthStep(ref reader) and reader.Depth-- matching existing formatters.

findings.claim: The generated-formatter diagnostics pipeline re-runs GeneratedFormatterCollector.Collect with ReferenceSymbols.TryCreate; when TryCreate fails (MessagePack not referenced), diagnostics are silently dropped and the model path also yields nothing. This is not a protection being disabled, so there is no security impact.

receipt_plan.detail: Read MessagePackGenerator.cs generatedFormatterDiagnostics SelectMany: no diagnostic is emitted when ReferenceSymbols.TryCreate fails.
